static_traits.name: Li Kexin
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with family and friends, but she has not yet revealed the extent of her frustration to them; has some Social support
static_traits.medical_history: No significant medical history; no psychological counseling received before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to identify and describe one's emotions and thoughts; highly cooperative, Positive attitude; but with a tendency to repeatedly ruminate on negative events and harsh self-blame

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling disappointed and Depressed because a stand-up comedy performance did not go as Anticipated. Although most of the audience responded with laughter and positive feedback, I fixate on the last joke that did not work, which makes me feel the whole performance failed.
basic_info.core_demands: The disappointment from the stand-up performance and being unable to move past that failed joke have affected my mood and confidence, so seeking counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough (not suited for stand-up comedy)

special_situations.event: The last joke in the stand-up performance did not get audience laughter
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any one joke fails, the whole performance counts as a failure; only when every component is perfect can it prove I am capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays and deduces the problem, vows to be perfect next time, temporarily avoids going on stage and socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I failed / I am not suited for stand-up comedy

special_situations.event: Received mixed audience feedback on the night of the show
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone does not laugh or questions, it means I am not funny enough, everyone is judging me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Paying excessive attention to negative feedback, ignoring positive evaluations, trying to 'correct mistakes' through self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am not funny

special_situations.event: Recalling the moment the audience did not laugh in daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I now feel shame and loss, showing that performance itself was bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Searches for 'evidence' through rumination, reducing creating and performing to avoid further setbacks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I feel terrible, so that time must have been terrible

special_situations.event: Considers whether to reveal true feelings of frustration to family and friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express disappointment, they will think I am melodramatic or not strong enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping Silence, Reduced socializing topics to avoid being evaluated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by audiences and significant others, proving her worth in comedy performance
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure, being negated or laughed at, thus being seen as not good enough
defense_goal: Avoiding further frustration through perfectionism and self-criticism
Maintains control and vigilance to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.object_representation: A picky audience/evaluator who may negate at any time

object_relations.self_representation: A person who hesitates to express needs and worries about being misunderstood
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may not understand or think she is 'too hard on herself'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Recalling the moment the audience did not laugh in counseling, talking about 'that failed joke'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating the present embarrassment and shame with not being good enough, believing oneself deserves blame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a self-blaming tone, lowering volume, repeatedly emphasizing one's inadequacy and mistakes, avoiding defending oneself.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to consider expressing genuine frustration to family and friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Assuming others will think she is melodramatic or not strong enough (projecting inner criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes 'what will they think of me', expresses worry in interrogative sentences, maintains a reserved and avoidant attitude.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides one to review positive feedback and make an objective assessment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Distances from emotional experiences such as shame by emphasizing standards, data, and logical analysis
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective statistics and analytical language, reducing emotional vocabulary, stating facts in a calm, restrained tone.

positive_force: Supportive relationships with family and friends
In performances, most jokes received audience laughter and positive feedback, providing evidence of actual ability
Work functioning basically stable, daily life maintained Good
Has tried focusing on positive feedback rationally, with some self-regulation awareness
negative_force: Perfectionism tendency, using black-and-white success/failure standards
Repeatedly ruminates on failure fragments; mental filtering of negative information
Negating positive feedback, overly relying on external evaluation to determine self-worth
Avoids socializing and performing again for fear of others' opinions
Self-labeling (such as 'failure/unqualified') leading to Decreased confidence and Reduced motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly ruminating about the unsuccessful joke, accompanied by loss and feelings of failure
antecedent: Seeing comedy-related cues (such as writing bits, comedy shows)
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionism and excessive focus on others' evaluations, catastrophizing and overgeneralizing one mistake into an overall failure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety of facing 'imperfection', trying to gain a sense of control and corrective plans through rumination
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and lowered Self-efficacy, Decreased drive for creation and re-performance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids socializing and creating/performing on stage again
antecedent: Thinking about needing to write new material or perform
Anticipating possibly being asked or evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing failure and judgment again, seeing embarrassment and shame as unbearable outcomes
target_behavior.function: Briefly avoiding Anxiety and potential embarrassment
target_behavior.consequence: Fewer positive experiences and practice opportunities, relationships and interest activities affected, Self-doubt maintained and aggravated
